name: Prologue complete (evening)
description: Both prologue quests done; Tomorrow's Heading points at the captain's bed.

name: Chapter 1: Morning on the Sapphire Sea
Chapter 3: Meet Garrick at the treasure door
Phase 4 Start
description: The captain has just slept after Phase 3. Morning; the ration is in the galley.

name: Morning Frog Grog
description: Arriving in the galley for the morning ration (the scene plays on arrival).

name: First Forecast
description: Garrick has unrolled the first crayon forecast on the breakfast table.

name: Breakfast Evacuation
description: 'That might be now.' The Center is in the galley; get up the ladder.

name: Life Around Center
description: Day 2 begins: the bell protocol is on the foremast.

name: Washroom Incident
description: Three bells: the Center is in the washroom with Gristle. Arriving in the crew quarters.

name: Galley Incident
description: Noon: the Center is sitting on Jim's stove. Close the stovepipe damper.

name: Night Evacuation
description: Three in the morning, three bells. Squawks is at the foot of the bed.

name: Quarterdeck Blocked
description: After the night: arriving on deck, the Center settles on the quarterdeck (the scene plays on arrival).

name: Seven Feathers
description: Day 6: Squawks wants his feathers counted, in the cabin.

name: Bald Again
description: The cloud has left the cabin. Take Squawks back in (the feathers fall on arrival).

name: Shark Duty
description: Day 7: the captain is on the roster. Take a pole from Jory's barrel.

name: Hundreds of Sharks
description: 'HOW MANY?' 'HUNDREDS.' Hold both rails.

name: Dead Center Shark Frenzy
description: Garrick has refused; three bells, the Center is heading for the port rail. Get Squawks.

name: Post-Frenzy Repairs
description: Late afternoon: the Center has moved off. Three repairs on the port rail.

name: Center Returns
description: Repairs done. Garrick has the afternoon forecast.

name: Final 700% Forecast
description: THE CENTER IS COMING BACK. Evacuate aft (or forward) for the last scenes and tomorrow's forecast.

name: Phase 4 Complete
description: Tomorrow: VERY BAD, 700%. The ship is free to explore.

name: Phase 5 Start
description: The morning after the 700% forecast. Make the rounds; Garrick is in a chair, facing a sheet.

name: Dead Center Panic
description: Rounds done. Three bells at the mainmast, and Squawks's basket is in the way. Grab him and get aft.

name: Squawks Check
description: Squawks is safe, aft, and fully bald. Check on him.

name: Grand Stenchmaster Duties
description: The first watch is over. Ask the Grand Stenchmaster what he actually does.

name: S.E.S. Reveal
description: The Stenchmaster Entertainment System has been unveiled. Have a look at it.

name: Shark Duty
description: Noon: hold both rails while the Grand Stenchmaster supervises from his chair.

name: Stenchmaster Suit Reveal
description: Garrick was found sewing in the hold. The crew are assembled on deck. Here it comes.

name: Crew Furious
description: The suit can't go near sharks (it's formalwear). Patch the starboard rail while he boasts.

name: Combined Emergency
description: Evening: more sharks than ever, the Center on the quarterdeck, Squawks by the wheel.

name: Night S.E.S. Scene
description: The labour rule is nailed up, Squawks is asleep. Look in on the S.E.S.

name: Phase 5 Complete
description: 'Programming.' 'Executive readiness.' The ship is free to explore.

name: Phase 6 Start
description: Sunset, a few days on. The suit has a saucepan lid on it now. Check on Squawks.

name: Rotten Garlic Supper
description: Garrick has the jar. Get down to the galley (with Squawks).

name: Frog Tax Man
description: Night. BWAAAAAH. Watch the S.E.S. with the Grand Stenchmaster.

name: S.E.S. Shutdown
description: Garrick won't wake; the set is sparking at full volume. Turn it off yourself: the knobs.

name: S.E.S. Death Rattle
description: OFF MAYBE worked. The set is dying anyway: crew to keep back, smoulders to smother, a barrel to move.

name: Almost Fires
description: After the POP: an ember on the Grand Stenchmaster's cape. The captain thinks about it.

name: Garrick Wakes
description: Dawn. 'WHO TURNED IT OFF?' Tell him what happened.

name: S.E.S. Apparently Dead
description: After Shark Duty: remind him of the labour rule. ('Throw it overboard.')

name: Midnight Warning
description: That night, in the sleeping quarters: Garrick wakes, and knows.

name: Sleeping Quarters Evacuation
description: Squawks is in your coat. Get the sleepers moving, then up the ladder.

name: Main Deck Refuge
description: On deck in the dark. Find somewhere safe. There isn't anywhere.

name: Final Warning
description: The countdown: 'Tradition starts somewhere.' Then BRACE.

name: Major Release
description: The mightiest gust yet: the ship inflates, the broadside goes off.

name: Second Yellow Apocalypse
description: A new cloud on the forward deck, garlic-pale. Get aft.

name: Shark Frenzy
description: Look over the port rail: the sharks have gone mad.

name: Great Sharkstorm Formation
description: The frenzy turns into a ring, a whirlpool, a column. Then a name.

name: Great Sharkstorm Attack
description: Sharks in the sky. Brace the shrouds, shelter Squawks, watch the shadows.

name: S.E.S. Shark Strike
description: The storm drinks the cloud; then a shark comes through the rail into the S.E.S.

name: Stinkbeard Breaking Point
description: Take the helm. Then the monologue. Then 'No.'

name: Frog Grog Discovery
description: A shark lands in the bulk reserve, swallows, and throws itself overboard.

name: Frog Grog Offensive
description: Roll barrels to the port rail and launch them into the storm.

name: Storm Driven Away
description: The column has collapsed. Everyone thinks it's dead. Look at the horizon.

name: Phase 6 Complete
description: The storm is on the horizon; the second cloud has the sleeping quarters; Garrick is banned from garlic for ever.

name: Phase 7 Start
description: Two days after Phase 6. Repairs, complaints, and the storm on the horizon nobody's looking at.

name: Sharkstorm Returning
description: Repairs done; Ned has called you forward. Look through the telescope.

name: Flying Sharks Return
description: THWACK. The storm is back on top of the ship. Which away?

name: Garrick TV Complaint
description: The rigging's fast, the main's reefed, Squawks is in your coat, the course is AWAY. The Grand Stenchmaster is shouting.

name: Not a Stenchmaster Duty
description: Franklin has an audit hearing tonight. The crew want the labour rule read out (the mainmast).

name: Grand Sharkmaster Argument
description: You have the rule in your hand. Read it to him (his chair).

name: Crew Job Revolt
description: A Grand Sharkmaster. The crew are gathering midships with a list.

name: Cape Shark
description: The list is complete. Take it to the Grand Stenchmaster (and mind the sky).

name: Stenchmaster Parade
description: The cape is torn; the crew chased him; now he's on parade. Help Pete, Bob and Jim.

name: Stenchmaster Song
description: One job left (Jim's crate). Then he sings.

name: S.E.S. Mark I Wrecked
description: The song is over. A shark finished the original S.E.S. Garrick is taking the ship apart for parts (the binnacle first).

name: Retreat Below
description: The storm worsens. Lash the wheel, then everyone below.

name: Mark II Construction
description: In the hold, sheltering. Watch the Grand Stenchmaster build a television (his bench).

name: Mark II Startup
description: Mark II is built. Keep his hands off the switch (talk to him). Twice.

name: Franklin Returns
description: It's on: snow, an orange tube, a suspicious blue one. The knobs (the set).

name: Crew Watches Frog Tax Man
description: Franklin is back. Nobody is watching it. Find something else to do.

name: Phase 7 Complete
description: The crew below, watching Franklin explain depreciation, the Great Sharkstorm overhead.

name: Phase 8 Start
description: The next afternoon (or so). A day and a half in the hold; the storm walking about on the roof. See how everyone's managing.

name: Lower Hull Shelter
description: Everyone's wedged in. Sit down in your corner, with Squawks: Franklin's being audited.

name: Garrick Rumbling
description: GLOOOORP. GRRRRRNNNK. Every head has turned. Somebody has to ask him (his chair).

name: False Alarm
description: 'I don't know.' 'Oh.' 'Ohhhh.' Full emergency: protect Squawks (your corner), then the stairs.

name: Sash Bearer Request
description: A false alarm. The fart is sneaky. No rowboat. Now he's looking at his sash (his chair).

name: Lost Fart Expedition
description: Nobody volunteered. FART SASH. Now: the costume trunk (by his chair).

name: Grand Crown Reveal
description: Professor Barnacle Bob is in his helmet. Now he's putting something on his own head (him).

name: Stinkbeard Fury
description: The crown, the premise, the landmarks (all in this room). That's enough. Hand Squawks to Gristle.

name: Sleeping Quarters Condemned
description: The storm eased, the Center moved on, Pete cracked the door: the fart took residence. Nail up the sign.

name: Lower Hull Barracks
description: The Grand Decree: the hold is the barracks now. Build it (hammocks, sailcloth, the floor, Squawks's bed, four bunks).

name: Barracks Complete
description: Everyone's sorted. Have a look at your own bunk (and what's over it).

name: Bedtime Story
description: Lights out. Get into your bunk. (He has a book.)

name: Grand Nap Start
description: The legend is told (the moral: hold the sash). He's getting into his hammock. In full attire.

name: Suit Fume Bunk
description: He's up there. You're under him. FWOoF.

name: Crown Fall
description: Bad bunk. Everyone drifts off. Then the crown slips.

name: Sash Descends
description: The crown's in a crate. Back in your bunk. Nearly asleep. Something touches your forehead.

name: Discount Store Reveal
description: LAST WEEK. Seventy per cent off. Cash only. No refunds. Wake the crew with the evidence (Pete, Gristle, Bob).

name: Phase 8 Complete
description: The sash cost three. NO ADVENTURE. Nobody slept; at three in the morning, Franklin's capital gains.

name: Phase 9 Start
description: The morning after the Grand Nap: grey light, nobody slept (except him). Starts the chapter 55 morning.

name: Morning After Grand Nap
description: Everyone's checked on (rope, a waffle, nine hundred and twelve snores, the butter). Wake him (the hammock over your bunk).

name: Sash History Lesson
description: He's on his rug with his crayon pictures. Ask him everything. Look interested.

name: Princess Stenchalina Story
description: The Sacred Stench is explained (and a CLEARANCE sticker seen). Now: who wore the sash first?

name: Five Grand Treasures
description: The ribbon fluttered; it's a fart sash in his own story. Now the Five Grand Treasures (Jim's bowl among them).

name: Discount Sash Confrontation
description: All of it heard, Admiral Thunderpants included. Thank him. Warmly. Then the discount bin.

name: Lost Fart Attempt Three
description: The witnesses have spoken. NO RECEIPT. Spiritual age; the plain purpose; the explorer's hat (attempt three).

name: Sash Bureaucracy
description: The hat's in the trunk. He's looking at Bob (by the mast). Bob resigns first.

name: Plain-Language Admission
description: Titles, a second title, the org chart, a Herald refused. Make him say it plainly. (Then: LAND.)

name: Land Sighted
description: FART SASH HOLDER. LAAAAND. Ned's at the gap in the hull by the stairs.

name: Crownskull Isle Reveal
description: A pale beach, reefs, jungle, cliffs, a ridge like a crowned skull. Hold your map up to it.

name: Landing Strategy
description: MY treasure; it followed us ('Strong scent'). Council round the map (the board by the barrels).

name: Grand Sharkmaster Appointment
description: Six ways ashore, six ways to die. A Grand Nap requested; a Grand Sharkmaster revived. Who gets pointed at?

name: Frog Tax Man Sharkstorm Coincidence
description: FORTY SECONDS. And the Mark II has come on by itself (the Mark II, by the rug).

name: Pete's Landing Plan
description: Records eaten by a shark; a shark storm; poor record-keeping. Pete has a plan, and he's furious about it.

name: Lee-Side Approach
description: Up on deck. Bring her round south of the reef (the helm), lines fast (the capstan), the decoy EMPTY (port davits).

name: Decoy Boat
description: Helm, lines, decoy: done. Launch the decoy with Pete and watch the fins for a window (starboard rail).

name: Crownskull Landing
description: The lure's thrown; the boats are down. Row through the reef to the beach (sharks still come down in the channel).

name: Jungle Exploration
description: Ashore. Follow the map (trail, ford, broken tooth, statue, X), or look round first: it's your island.

name: Crimson Fortune Site
description: The statue points north. The clearing under the skull.

name: Digging Start
description: THE FORTUNE OF THE CRIMSON KINGS. Everyone's share promised (Squawks: a gold pouch). Seven floors. Dig at the X.

name: Garrick Quits Digging
description: The sand's out. Give the Grand Stenchmaster his turn with the shovel.

name: Excavation Proposal
description: Three floors down, four to go: days. He has a proposal.

name: Launch Sequence
description: NO. Then the howl, the birds, the crown rattling, the ground humming. Ask him.

name: Evacuation Run
description: Launch command acknowledged. RUN: west along the path out of the clearing, to the beach.

name: Western Beach Trap
description: Out onto the western beach... where the storm is too.

name: Ancient Ruins Shelter
description: Between a Sharkstorm and a Garrick: the ruins. Make the shelter (stone, brace, beam, cloth).

name: Final Warning
description: Eighty-five and a half per cent. Squawks is in his corner. Watch the clearing (step into a gap in the ruins' south wall).

name: Excavation Blast
description: THERE IS NO TEAM. FIRE IN THE HOLE.

name: Great Sharkstorm Inland
description: Bad digging. The storm smelled it and came in. Get back to Squawks in the shelter.

name: Great White Rain
description: Halfway across the ruins' yard, great whites coming down (marked first).

name: Megalodon Arrival
description: Back with Squawks. Then a shadow the size of the ship.

name: Treasure Exposed
description: The megalodon's in the lagoon. Down in the crater: the Crimson Fortune, exposed. It WORKED.

name: Treasure Blown Away
description: It worked... and it keeps going. MY MONEY. NOT THAT ONE.

name: Crowned Megalodon
description: The fortune's in the storm. Something small and bright falls out of it, towards the lagoon.

name: Treasure-Laden Sharkstorm
description: Pfft. The storm glitters; jewelled sharks go over. Go and look in the crater.

name: Stinkbeard Rage Shanty
description: Two per cent, reeking. A crowned megalodon. Something in the captain lets go.

name: Recovery Quest Unlocked
description: Vertical relocation; suit memory; richer than pirates (currently). WE MUST RECOVER IT.

name: Phase 9 Complete
description: IT. WINKED. Recover the Crimson Fortune (open). Crownskull Isle to wander; the boats go back to the Revenge.
